title: Fragomatic
wikitext:
One of the most solid teams ever. In 2005 '''Fragomatic''' won [[Nations Quake Rank|NQR]], [[European Quake League|EQL]] and [[Challenge Smackdown|SD]] winning all but 2 maps.

== History ==
The team had disbanded in 2006 after [[manulito]] stopped playing, [[valla]] joined [[Team Freedom]] and [[Xterm]] joined [[Slackers]], leaving [[XantoM]] without a team. They revived in August [[2007]] however, after valla and Xterm left [[Slackers]] to join XantoM again. After this long break they play [[EQL Season 6]] and [[NQR Season 11]]. The new team featured the old players, as mentioned before Martin (Valla), Pascal (Xterm) and XantoM but also a lot of new players, [[mrlame]], [[nabbe]], [[riker]], [[inferno]], [[inter]], who played with the older members in clans such as [[Lege Artis]], [[Disorder]] and [[Dota Allstar Guys]] before. After the season [[Xterm]] [[nabbe]] and valla took a break while XantoM joined [[The Viper Squad]] for the upcoming season.

[[2008]]: Fragomatic gathered some new troops ([[razor_(Swedish_Player)|razor]], [[moltas]], [[cage]]), they signed up, but didn't manage to play in [[EQL Season 8]].

[[2009]]: [[Xterm]], [[nabbe]], [[valla]], [[riker]] and [[Inferno]] sign up for EQL Season 10 and despite only [[valla]] and [[Xterm]] playing active they manage to reach the semifinal where they go down to [[Slackers]].

[[2011]]: After reaching four [[EQL]] semifinals in a row [[Fusion]] falls apart and also [[The Viper Squad]], six time [[EQL]] winners, maybe unexpected by some because they might've been able to gather four players, doesn't come back for [[EQL Season 14]]. [[Martin]], [[Pascal]] and [[Rikoll]] from [[Fusion]] and [[XantoM]] and [[Milton]] from the new Fragomatic lineup, bringing three of the old winning team back together, joined by [[Milton]] who arguably has been the best quakeworld player for several years and [[Rikoll]] who has proven to be one of the best duelers in current days and has also shown great skill in [[4on4]] making this the favourite team for the title in every competition they enter.

[[2012]]: With only one map loss throughout the entire season of [[EQL Season 14]], playoffs included, Fragomatic decided to split up for [[EQL Season 15]]. With the purpose of boosting the activity in general, and motivation of division 1 teams in particular, in an declining QuakeWorld scene, a split-up was decided as the best choice. Martin and Milton went off to create a new team (ParamedicS), Rikoll joined clan Chosen while Xterm and XantoM decided to take a break. All three of the Swedish players; [[Xterm]], Martin and XantoM, were all part of the Fragomatic team that won the first season of EQL, almost exactly six years ago (2006-01-11).

[[2014]]: Fragomatic returned for [[EQL Season 19]] consisting of [[XantoM]], [[Xterm]], [[valla]], [[Milton]], [[Creature]] and [[maga]] - a mix of players from the original Fragomatic and [[The Viper Squad]]. Having played the entire group stage without a map loss Fragomatic faced the [[EQL Season 18]] champions [[Suddendeath]] in the highly anticipated final. The final turned out to be a real thriller with map scores of 146-192 ([[dm3]]), 227-242 ([[e1m2]]) and 288-157 ([[dm2]]) ([http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql19/matches.php?id=63 view match report]).

[[2015]]: [[XantoM]], [[Milton]], [[HENU]], [[Diki]] and [[Creature]] signed up to play [[EQL Season 20]] under the name "Fragomatic" (although the team was more similar to former [[The Viper Squad]] lineups). Having played the group stage with one game lost vs [[Suddendeath]], [[Fragomatic]] faced and won [[Crazy 88]] in the semi-final. The grand final was played vs [[Suddendeath]] were [[Fragomatic]] got revenge won with 3-0 ([http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql20/matches/115 view match report]) claiming the EQL20 victory.

[[2016]]: Fragmatic signed up for [[EQL Season 21]] with the same team as in [[EQL Season 20]] (XantoM, Milton, HENU, Diki, Creature).
